assumptions.choice: Calendar signals submit standard Backtrader market orders, which execute on the next available bar under the harness defaults.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define same-bar execution or enable cheat-on-close/open behavior.

assumptions.choice: Size is the largest whole-share quantity affordable using available cash, the current close as the sizing reference, and the configured 0.001 commission.
assumptions.reason: Backtrader orders require a size, and all available capital cannot purchase fractional shares.

assumptions.choice: The stop-loss is submitted after the entry buy order completes, at 2% below its actual executed price.
assumptions.reason: This is the literal entry price available in Backtrader.

assumptions.choice: Any active stop-loss order is canceled when the first-February exit is submitted.
assumptions.reason: Prevents the stop order from remaining active after the position is closed.
